Amazon is a global technology company whose engineers build scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products. Annapurna Labs is seeking an early-career Software Development Engineer I to develop, test, optimize, and debug production software across custom silicon hardware and software stacks, while collaborating with hardware, compiler, and systems teams.

Responsibilities
Designing, implementing, and testing software across the stack - from low-level systems code to compilers, runtimes, and tooling
Writing efficient, maintainable code in languages such as C, C++, or Python
Optimizing software performance on custom hardware (Graviton, Trainium, Inferentia)
Debugging complex issues across the hardware-software boundary
Collaborating with hardware, compiler, and systems teams to deliver features end-to-end
Documenting your work and presenting results to the team

Required
Bachelor's or Master's degree program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with a final graduation date of May 2027 or later
Programming experience in at least one modern language such as C, C++, Java, or Python
Coursework or project experience in data structures, algorithms, and software design
Understanding of core computer science fundamentals: operating systems, computer architecture, or systems programming
Preferred
Bachelor's or Master's degree with a focus on systems, compilers, computer architecture, or high-performance computing
Experience with low-level or systems programming in C/C++ (memory management, concurrency, performance optimization)
Familiarity with compilers (MLIR, LLVM, TVM), ML runtimes, operating systems internals, or distributed systems
Exposure to machine learning frameworks and an understanding of how models run on hardware
Prior internship, research, or open-source contribution experience in systems, compilers, or ML infrastructure
